idea.title: Show HN: Streambench – Native Mac Client for Kafka and NATS
idea.description: Build a native Mac client for Kafka and NATS messaging systems using a static HTML/CSS/JS website. The client will allow users to send and receive messages through these systems without any need for database or payment integration.
